prompt:
EDIT THIS IMAGE. Make EXACTLY ONE change: TAKE THE BLACK MASK OFF HIS FACE.

Remove the black domino mask completely and paint in the face that was underneath it: the same man's brow, eyes, eyelids and the bridge of his nose, in the same skin tone as his cheeks and forehead, with the same flat low-poly faceting. His eyes are pale and level, looking the same direction his head is already turned - proud, tired, imperious. Keep his eyebrows heavy and tawny to match his beard. The exposed skin takes the same warm amber key from the viewer's left and the same deep navy shadow on the right as the rest of his face already has.

EVERYTHING ELSE IS ABSOLUTELY LOCKED - it is the SAME man in the SAME picture: same head shape, same hairline and hair, same full tawny beard and moustache, same jaw, same nose, same mouth, same head angle and three-quarter turn to the viewer's left, same neck, same body, same pose, same stance, same hands, same proportions, same silhouette, same cloak, same orange lining, same cream waistcoat, same navy cravat, same trousers, same boots, same lighting, same colours, same flat low-poly faceted style, same position and same size in the frame, same flat magenta background. Change nothing but the removal of the mask.

OUTPUT ONE SINGLE NEW IMAGE in the tall portrait shape of panel A. Do not output this sheet or its captions.

Reproduce panel A EXACTLY - the same standing masked man, same pose, same three-quarter turn to the viewer's left, same colossal build, same cloak with orange lining, same cream waistcoat, same boots, same warm-amber-from-the-left lighting, same deep navy shadow on his right, same flat low-poly faceted paint, same framing and size in frame, same flat magenta background - WITH ONE CHANGE ONLY: he is NOT wearing the black mask.

The face revealed under the mask is the face in panel B: heavy tawny brows, level pale eyes, strong straight nose, proud and imperious. Panel B tells you WHO HE IS; panel A tells you everything else. Paint the uncovered brow, eyes and nose bridge in the same skin tone and the same flat facets as the rest of his face, taking the same warm key from the viewer's left.

No mask, no eye covering, no ribbon, no shadow across the eyes. Flat solid magenta background, edge to edge, no gradient, no floor, no cast shadow.

EDIT THIS IMAGE. It is one wide strip holding FOUR copies of the same masked man, evenly spaced left to right. KEEP the wide strip, KEEP the four evenly spaced positions, KEEP each figure the same height and standing on the same ground line, KEEP the flat magenta background edge to edge.

THE ONE CHANGE: turn the four identical standing figures into the FOUR FRAMES OF A WALK CYCLE, and turn every figure to a STRICT SIDE PROFILE facing the VIEWER'S LEFT - we see his left side, his nose and beard point left, he is walking leftwards across the frame.

Frame 1 (leftmost): CONTACT - legs scissored wide apart, his leading (left) leg reaching forward heel down, trailing leg extended back toes down, cloak swung back behind him.
Frame 2: PASSING - legs together, the trailing leg lifted and passing under the body knee bent, torso at its highest, cloak hanging nearly straight.
Frame 3: CONTACT, MIRRORED - legs scissored wide the other way, the other leg now reaching forward heel down, cloak swung back.
Frame 4: PASSING, MIRRORED - legs together again, the other leg lifted and passing under the body, cloak hanging nearly straight.

Across all four he is THE SAME MAN, unchanged: same colossal build, same black domino mask, same tawny hair and full beard, same steel-blue floor-length cloak with bright orange lining, same cream waistcoat, same dark trousers, same tall boots, same size, same flat low-poly faceted paint, same warm amber key light from the viewer's LEFT and deep navy shadow behind. Arms swing naturally opposite the legs. Head level and steady, eyes forward, never bobbing out of line.

No panel borders, no frames, no dividing lines, no numbers, no text, no ground shadow, no floor. Just four figures on flat solid magenta.
